label: resolved68-seal
command:
import gzip, hashlib, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, shutil
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); folder=pathlib.Path('/work/home/resolved68-seal'); folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
manifest=json.loads((root/'v43-last-manifest.json').read_bytes())
source=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(manifest,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert source=='4d28113802de70f2624f3d5146f5e8f22508103e6ae8f255575d2ea62d935631',source
def sha(path):
 with path.open('rb') as stream:return hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
specpath=root/'scientific/resolved-v68/specifications.json'
specs=json.loads(specpath.read_bytes()); specsha=sha(specpath)
packets=[]
for spec in specs:
 path=pathlib.Path('/work/home/resolved68-campaign')/(spec['id']+'.json')
 with path.open() as stream:packet=json.load(stream)
 assert packet['sourceSHA256']==source and packet['specificationSHA256']==specsha
 assert len(packet['cases'])==1
 case=packet['cases'][0]
 assert case['id']==spec['id'] and case['spec']==spec and case['failure'] is None
 assert len(case['steps'])==case['requestedSteps']==spec['steps']
 del packet,case
 rawsha=sha(path); compressed=folder/(spec['id']+'.json.gz')
 with path.open('rb') as inp,compressed.open('xb') as out:
  with gzip.GzipFile(filename='',mode='wb',fileobj=out,mtime=0,compresslevel=6) as stream:shutil.copyfileobj(inp,stream)
 with gzip.open(compressed,'rb') as stream:assert hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()==rawsha
 packets.append({'id':spec['id'],'rawFile':str(path),'rawBytes':path.stat().st_size,'rawSHA256':rawsha,
                 'gzipFile':compressed.name,'gzipSHA256':sha(compressed),'gzipBytes':compressed.stat().st_size,
                 'sourceSHA256':source,'specificationSHA256':specsha,'acceptedSteps':spec['steps']})
names=[name for name in manifest if name.startswith(('src/','scientific/resolved-v68/','scientific/current-v66/','scientific/transient-v67/'))]
names += ['package.json','package-lock.json','tsconfig.json','tests/fuel-current-reuse-v68.test.ts','tests/fixtures/graded-wall-v67-stall.json',
          'run-final-gates-v38.py','run-final-gates-v39.py']
copied={}
for name in sorted(set(names)):
 path=root/name
 assert name in manifest and sha(path)==manifest[name],name
 target=folder/'source'/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(path,target)
 copied[name]=manifest[name]
shutil.copyfile(root/'v43-last-manifest.json',folder/'tested-inputs.json')
index={'sourceSHA256':source,'specificationSHA256':specsha,'packets':packets,'sourceCopiesSHA256':copied,
       'versions':{name:importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ('numpy','scipy','fipy')},
       'relocation':'Retain original configs. Decompress untouched packet bytes to a new folder; make a separately hashed replay config with only packet paths changed. Keep packet/source SHA256 unchanged.',
       'completeSourceManifest':'tested-inputs.json','experimentalValidation':False,'liveBackendChanged':False}
(folder/'index.json').write_text(json.dumps(index,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'packets':len(packets),'acceptedSteps':sum(p['acceptedSteps'] for p in packets),'sourceFiles':len(copied),
 'sourceSHA256':source,'specificationSHA256':specsha,'gzipBytes':sum(p['gzipBytes'] for p in packets),'indexSHA256':sha(folder/'index.json')},indent=2))
